meta.name: gohighlevel
meta.description: Operate connected GoHighLevel CRM accounts through the NotFair MCP. Use for GoHighLevel, HighLevel, GHL contacts, conversations, opportunities, calendars, pipelines, tags, tasks, forms, invoices, products, or approved CRM changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 帮你查看并更新 CRM 里的客户、商机与日程安排
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果客户和商机都在 CRM 里,想直接对话式地查询和更新
copy.tagline_en: Look up and update CRM contacts, deals, and calendars through chat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your contacts and deals live in a CRM and you want to update them by chat

howto.what: 通过 NotFair MCP 操作已连接的 GoHighLevel 账户:读取联系人、对话、商机、日历等数据;只有你明确要求时才写入,改前先展示 location、现值、提议值、风险与回滚方式,改后再回读确认。
howto.when: 当你提到 GoHighLevel、GHL、联系人、商机等关键词,或要求查询、修改已连接的 HighLevel 账户时触发;连接缺失、未授权或只读时会让你重新连接并停止。

say.text: 列出这个 GoHighLevel 账户的联系人
say.note: 先做一次无害读取确认 location

say.text: 把这个商机阶段改成已成交
say.note: 改前会展示现值并等你批准

say.text: 查一下本周这个 location 的日历事件
say.note: Agency 连接需显式给 locationId

howto.what_en: Operates connected GoHighLevel CRM accounts via the NotFair MCP: reads contacts, conversations, opportunities and calendars. Writes only when you explicitly ask, showing location, current value, proposed change and rollback first, then reading back to confirm.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention GoHighLevel, GHL, contacts, opportunities and similar, or ask to read or change a connected HighLevel account. If the connector is missing, unauthorized or read-only for a write, it asks you to reconnect and stops.

say_en.text: List the contacts in this GoHighLevel account
say_en.note: Starts with a harmless read to confirm the location

say_en.text: Change this opportunity stage to won
say_en.note: Shows current value and waits for approval first

say_en.text: Show this location's calendar events this week
say_en.note: Agency connections need an explicit locationId
